name: regularization_20261118
selection_rule: For each trial and variant, average RMSE/known-spot RMSE equally over eligible target years, then horizons, then architectures. Confirm the best two conditions plus signals/control. Rank confirmed conditions over all three seeds; differences below 0.005 favor fewer recurrent branches, then fewer parameters, then trial declaration order.
walk_forward_policy: Check the selected condition and the common control with the same three cells; this retrospective development check does not change the selected condition and is not an independent test.
ridge_input: Last observed feature vector; alpha selected on the internal pre-training-boundary block
refit_policy: Choose epoch only in internal data; reset weights and train all pre-boundary samples for that fixed epoch count; never evaluate the scored block inside epoch selection or refitting.
budget: 60 fixed-search jobs, 20 conditions each compared on all 3 cells; then at most 18 confirmation jobs and 12 walk-forward jobs; separate-horizon jobs contain 3 branches and each branch has selection and refit phases. No further search rounds based on results.
